estimates.assumptions: 3 medium-large beef tomatoes ≈ 600 g total edible flesh; standard values for raw red tomatoes
½ medium red onion ≈ 55 g raw edible portion
small handful fresh thyme sprigs ≈ 5 g; modest quantity for seasoning/to taste
1 tbsp sherry vinegar ≈ 15 g; negligible macros
2 tbsp extra-virgin olive oil ≈ 27 g; all oil is used in the dish (dressing + pan drizzle)
100 g chorizo (standard cured Spanish-style); all fat rendered into pan is accounted in the 2 tbsp olive oil line, so only meat macros here
